column8: The bounded resolver reproduces the source prepared self-join field contract for declaration order, database name, and visible aliases, plus qualified/unqualified and LEFT/comma binding; automatic LEFT/USING projections now route direct columns and aliases through the isolated metadata contract while proving nullable/coalesced output order, but prepared statement lifecycle, typed expressions, planner predicate typing, and the remainder of TestPrepared remain open.
